Name: Neo-Brutal
Description: Необруталізм: пласкі кольори, товсті контури, жорсткі тіні без розмиття та різкі анімації.
StyleResources:
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:fx="clr-namespace:CategoryBar.Theming;assembly=CategoryBar">
  <!--
    Neo-Brutal. Blocks stand on hard shadows that the stylesheet draws. A hovered block lifts and tilts, a pressed
    or open one drops onto its shadow. States switch at once, without easing: the shift itself is the feedback.
  -->

  <!-- Tabs: separate blocks. The open one is pushed down into its shadow and filled with the accent. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.TabTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Grid x:Name="block" fx:ThemeTransform.X="0" fx:ThemeTransform.Y="0" fx:ThemeTransform.Angle="0">
        <ContentControl x:Name="face" Focusable="False" IsHitTestVisible="False" Template="{DynamicResource Theme.ControlMaterialTemplate}" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" Tag="{DynamicResource tab.Radius}" Effect="{DynamicResource tab.Shadow}"/>
        <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
        <Border x:Name="running" Width="9" Height="9" Margin="0,-4,-4,0" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Top" Background="{DynamicResource Accent.Fill}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Surface.Border}" BorderThickness="1.5" Visibility="Collapsed" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="-2"/><Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Y" Value="-2"/>
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Angle" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.tilt}"/>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsRunning" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="running" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsSelected" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="face" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Background}"/><Setter TargetName="face" Property="Effect" Value="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Shadow}"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Foreground}"/>
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.shadow}"/><Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Y" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.shadow}"/>
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Angle" Value="0"/>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsDropTarget" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="face" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Background}"/><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Foreground}"/>
      </Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- Buttons behave like the blocks they are: lift on hover, drop when pressed. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.ButtonTemplate" TargetType="Button">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Grid x:Name="block" fx:ThemeTransform.X="0" fx:ThemeTransform.Y="0">
        <ContentControl x:Name="face" Focusable="False" IsHitTestVisible="False" Template="{DynamicResource Theme.ControlMaterialTemplate}" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" Tag="{DynamicResource button.Radius}" Effect="{DynamicResource button.Shadow}"/>
        <Border x:Name="state" Background="Transparent" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource button.Radius}" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
        <Border x:Name="focus" Margin="3" BorderThickness="1.5" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource button.Radius}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
        <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}" VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding VerticalContentAlignment}"/>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="state" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource button:hover.Background}"/><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource button:hover.Foreground}"/>
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="-1"/><Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Y" Value="-1"/>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="face" Property="Effect" Value="{DynamicResource button:pressed.Shadow}"/>
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="3"/><Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Y" Value="3"/>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="focus" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45"/></Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.PrimaryButtonTemplate" TargetType="Button">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Grid x:Name="block" fx:ThemeTransform.X="0" fx:ThemeTransform.Y="0">
        <ContentControl x:Name="face" Focusable="False" IsHitTestVisible="False" Template="{DynamicResource Theme.ControlMaterialTemplate}" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" Tag="{DynamicResource button-primary.Radius}" Effect="{DynamicResource button-primary.Shadow}"/>
        <Border x:Name="state" Background="Transparent" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource button-primary.Radius}" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
        <Border x:Name="focus" Margin="3" BorderThickness="1.5" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource button-primary.Radius}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
        <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}" VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding VerticalContentAlignment}"/>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="state" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource button-primary:hover.Background}"/><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource button-primary:hover.Foreground}"/>
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="-1"/><Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Y" Value="-1"/>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="face" Property="Effect" Value="{DynamicResource button-primary:pressed.Shadow}"/>
        <Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="3"/><Setter TargetName="block" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Y" Value="3"/>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="focus" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45"/></Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- The title bar is a filled strip closed by an ink line. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.TitleBarTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid Background="{TemplateBinding Background}">
      <ContentPresenter/>
      <Border Height="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.border}" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Background="{DynamicResource Surface.Border}" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
    </Grid>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <!-- Navigation is a column closed by the same ink line on its right. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.SidebarTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid Background="{TemplateBinding Background}">
      <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"/>
      <Border Width="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.border}" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Background="{DynamicResource Surface.Border}" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
    </Grid>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <!-- The category name is a label block inside the menu. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.MenuHeaderTemplate" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
    <Border Margin="0,0,0,6" Background="{DynamicResource Accent.Fill}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Surface.Border}" BorderThickness="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.border.Thickness}" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource tab.Radius}">
      <Grid Margin="10,5,4,5" MinHeight="24"><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
        <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding Tag}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" VerticalAlignment="Center" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
        <ContentPresenter Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
      </Grid>
    </Border>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <Style x:Key="Theme.MenuHeader" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface"><Setter Property="Template" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.MenuHeaderTemplate}"/><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.FillText}"/></Style>

  <!-- Square switch and boxed segments. -->
  <Style x:Key="Toggle" TargetType="CheckBox">
    <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="CheckBox">
          <Grid Width="46" Height="26" Background="Transparent">
            <Border x:Name="track" Background="{DynamicResource Control.Bg}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Surface.Border}" BorderThickness="2" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource button.Radius}"/>
            <Border x:Name="knob" Width="14" Height="14" Margin="6,0,0,0" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Background="{DynamicResource Surface.Border}" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource button.Radius}" fx:ThemeTransform.X="0"/>
          </Grid>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="track" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.Fill}"/>
              <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.FillText}"/>
              <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="20"/>
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45"/></Trigger>
          </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>
  </Style>
  <Style x:Key="Segment" TargetType="RadioButton">
    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource Text}"/><Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12.5"/><Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="RadioButton">
          <Border x:Name="box" MinHeight="30" Padding="12,4" Background="Transparent" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource button.Radius}">
            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
          </Border>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="box" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.Soft}"/></Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="box" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource Text}"/><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource Window.Bg}"/></Trigger>
          </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>
  </Style>

  <!-- Motion: things are slammed into place. Linear, short, no fading. -->
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Bar.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="46" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Tab.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.02"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="-26" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.1"/>
    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Angle)">
      <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="-7"/><DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="3"/><DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.16" Value="0"/>
    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.02"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="28" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.09"/>
    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Angle)">
      <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="-3"/><DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.09" Value="1.5"/><DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.14" Value="0"/>
    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" To="22" Duration="0:0:0.06"/>
    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"><DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.06" Value="0"/></DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Switch" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="-14" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.07"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.MenuItem.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.02"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="-30" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.08"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Card.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.02"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="36" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.1"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Page.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.01"/></Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Window.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="1.04" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.09"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="90" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.11"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" To="120" Duration="0:0:0.09"/>
    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"><DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.09" Value="0"/></DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
  </Storyboard>
</ResourceDictionary>

Parameters.Label: Затримка між елементами
Parameters.Description: Вкладки, рядки меню й картки з’являються одна за одною.
